_doc: Reviewed extraction of Table III-B, 'Area irrigated by different sources', from the DES Season and Crop Report. Every figure here was read from the report PDF by a person and is re-verified against the PDF before this file changes; scripts/atlas-irrigation-tn-district.ts validates it and writes the served artifact. Net area by source is what the report prints per column group; supplementary wells water land already counted under another source and are NOT additive to the net total.

source.table: III-B, Area irrigated by different sources, pages 125-131

supplementaryWellsNote: The report's supplementary-wells column ('by all other types of wells') records 694 ha net for this district in 2024-25; it waters land already counted under another source and is not added to the net total.
notes: The five source components sum to 104560 ha against the printed net total of 104560 ha (exact).
Open wells 72.7%, tube and bore wells 15.9%, tanks 5.6%, canals 4.5%, other sources 1.2% of the net irrigated area.
The report prints 107729 ha gross and 3169 ha irrigated more than once; gross minus net is 3169 ha, matching. The per-source gross columns sum to 107727 ha.
